comments.text: Tile 0 of tile set 7, blank as in every set (11, 31 and 84 are blank too): the black road surface of map 21, 44 squares at x 3-28, y 17-31, and the off-map tile of maps 13 and 15. Set 7 serves four maps of side 4: 7 (its texts: 'Stainless steel corridors extend into the darkness.'), 13 ('Shelves full of books stand before you.'), 15 ('Chopper simulation module.') and 21 ('Leaving Darwin Village.', 'Entering Black Gilva Tavern.').

Tiles 1-6, the figures every set shares (1 grey robot-like humanoid, 2 red and orange one-eyed hulk, 3 yellow and green runner, 4 man in a cyan shirt, 5 tied sack, 6 brown horned creature), none in set 7's layers. Computed from the records, the encounter squares would show 1 (map 7: 1, map 15: 3) or 6 (map 7: 3); maps 13 and 21 have none. Tile 5 shows on the loot-bag squares, eight of map 13 (x 21-30, y 11-16) and map 15's (20, 26).

Tile 7, the green-shirted party figure game $AF1D-$AF25 draws on the party's square; map 21 also has it as a person on three squares of its layer, (3, 1), (11, 9) and (9, 11), and its class-4 squares (25, 1) and (27, 1) show it over the floor 95. The self-modified LDA operand of draw_tile ($2367) points here, tile 7 being the last drawn.

Tile 8, the radiation sign shown on class-9 squares from 18:00 to 05:59 by draw_square ($0B80-$0B8A); maps 7, 13, 15 and 21 have no class-9 square and no 8 in their layers, so set 7's copy is not drawn as they load.

Tile 9 of set 7, the purple peak over light blue and blue bars that sets 1-5 and 8 share: game $AD13-$AD49 draws it for each of the player's other parties standing on the same map. In none of set 7's layers.

Tiles 10-14 of set 7: 10 the one-eyed hulk of tile 2 in brown and orange, unused by the maps; 11 blank, unused; 12 set 3's blue building entrance 60 (map 21 at (12, 21), class 10); 13 and 14 black with a small white square, hollow black, in the top left (map 21: 4) or bottom right corner (6), class-1 squares where road edges meet.

Tiles 15-21 of set 7, the orange blocks of sets 2, 4, 5 and 8, shaded brown at the right or bottom: 15 (5 squares: maps 7, 13, 21 one each, map 15 two, its (20, 26) a loot-bag square), 16 (map 13: 5), 17 (map 13: 2), 18 (map 7: 1, 13: 4), 19 (map 13: 6), 20 (map 13 at (4-6, 12)), 21 (map 13: 3, map 15: 1).

Tiles 22-26 of set 7: 22 a white, light blue and dark grey box with a T-shaped grille (map 13: 4, class 6, at the foot of its south wall, x 20-29, y 30); 23-26 light blue, grey and white bands, a corner from west to south (23), a corner from north to west (24), upright (25) and across (26): a bracket on map 13 at x 21-22, y 13-15, and the frame round the block of 59 and 60 on map 15 at x 24-27, y 1-4.

Tiles 27-31 of set 7, set 3's white road lines on black: 27 a top left corner, unused by the maps; the edges right (28: 28 squares), bottom (29: 48) and left (30: 28) along map 21's roads at y 17-31; 31 blank, unused.

Tiles 32-34 of set 7: 32 and 33 a white and blue box drawn at an angle over the purple lattice, two ways round (32 at map 13's (14, 1), class 2; 33 in no layer, but the tile of map 13's class-4 record 1 ($3C76), which (14, 1), a locked cabinet (check record 37, $3C5C), becomes once it has been opened and the loot bag it turns into (record 8, $3CD0) emptied); 34 black under a white top edge, set 3's road edge 64 (map 21: 53).

Tiles 35 and 36 of set 7: 35 sparse green dashes on black, the ground of map 21 (231 squares, 155 of them class 11) and the off-map tile of maps 7 and 21; 36 a brown chair with its back at the left, unused by the maps.

Tiles 37-40 of set 7: 37 and 38 blue blocks with light blue edges (map 21: 2 and 10); 39 a piece of the banded wall with black marks, map 7's (17, 10) where a wall meets a corner; 40 set 3's blue block with black cracks (map 21 at (30, 22) and (7, 23)); all class 11.
Tiles 41 and 42 of set 7: 41 dense green dashes on black (map 21: 192 squares, 125 of them class 11); 42 a white bottom left corner on black, unused by the maps.

Tiles 43-46 of set 7: 43 and 44 the left and right halves of a white and cyan shape pointing right inside a purple frame, six of them, in two columns of three, in map 13's room at x 11-15, y 18-22; 45 and 46 set 3's white top right and bottom right corners, unused by the maps.

Tiles 47-50 of set 7, the rounded ends of the banded blue, light blue and white walls (47: 7 squares, 48: 23, 49: 9, 50: 12, on maps 7, 13 and 15), all class 11; 16 of the 48s top the two rows of small cells on map 7 (y 13 and 19).
Tile 51 of set 7, purple ovals in a black lattice, the floor of maps 7, 13 and 15 (631, 566 and 609 squares; 349 class 11, 7 loot-bag squares).

Tiles 52-57 of set 7, bands of light blue, white and blue that turn corners or run straight with a short branch, the walls of maps 7, 13 and 15 (52: 40 squares, 53: 201, 54: 20, 55: 20, 56: 243, 57: 19), class 11 but map 15's (24, 22), a class-4 square that shows 56 over its own 56; 52 and 53 are set 5's too.

Tiles 58-60 of set 7, set 8's bitmaps in other colours, 58 and 59 over purple specks: 58 a dark grey, green and white shape (map 13: 6, four of them a row at x 21-30, y 27; map 15: 2; six of the eight class 8); 59 a light blue, brown and white one (map 13 at (27-30, 2), map 15 at (25, 1-3)); 60 brown, light grey and white rings over white bars (map 13: 7, map 15: 6).

Tiles 61 and 62 of set 7: 61 grey and white stones, the walls of map 21's northern buildings, with ten squares at x 12-19, y 29-31 (127 squares, class 11); 62 set 3's blue building entrance 54 (map 21 at (13, 20), (24, 20), (7, 27) and (24, 27), class 10).

Tiles 63-66 of set 7: 63 yellow zigzags on grey (map 15: 7, six of them a row at x 24-29, y 26); 64 a brown chair with its back at the left over the purple lattice (map 13: 3, map 15 at (17, 21)); 65 blue panels in a white frame with red marks, unused by the maps; 66 white rungs between black rails, the class-8 square (1, 28) of each of maps 7, 13 and 15.
Tiles 67-71 of set 7, more pieces of the banded walls, straight runs with branches and crossings (67: 173 squares, set 5's 67; 68: 19; 69: 28; 70: 37; 71: 31), on maps 7, 13 and 15, all class 11.

Tiles 72-74 of set 7: 72 a blue building edge with a white and black gap (map 21 at (2, 21) and (9, 23), class 10); 73 a blue square speckled red and white (19 squares in the rooms of map 7, 16 class 1); 74 a banded wall run with a branch (219 squares of maps 7, 13 and 15, class 11).
Tiles 75-77 of set 7, pieces of map 21's blue buildings: 75 (8 squares), 76 set 3's 78 (14) and 77 set 3's 82 (6), all class 11.

Tiles 78-80 of set 7: 78 and 79 dark grey with black chevrons pointing right and down, as in sets 5 and 8 (78 unused by the maps; 79 on map 13 at (20, 28), (23, 28), (26, 28) and (29, 28), two squares above the grilles 22, and on map 15 at (28, 21-22)); 80 set 2's door 32 in light blue and brown (37 squares on all four maps, 27 class 2, 4 class 10).

Tiles 81-87 of set 7: 81 red, blue and white checks between white uprights, unused by the maps; 82 a figure in purple behind a brown counter, set 4's 86 (map 21 at (26, 3), class 10); 83 brown rungs between brown rails (map 7 at (13-15, 0), class 10); 84 blank; 85 a blue block edged light blue and white (map 21: 15); 86 a red cross on white, set 2's 71 (map 13 at (1, 13) and (5, 20), class 10); 87 a light blue square crossed by dark grey lines in a white frame (map 15 at (28, 20)).

Tiles 88-95 of set 7: 88, 89, 93 and 94 set 3's blue building pieces 88, 87, 86 and 79 (map 21: 13, 15, 7 and 16 squares); 90 solid white, unused; 91 and 92 solid blue, the same bytes (91: 6 squares of map 15, 92: 6 of map 21); 95 rows of green dashes, the floor of map 21's northern buildings (127 squares, 120 class 1).
Colour bytes of tiles 0-9 in set 7 (high nibble: pixel pairs 01, low nibble: pairs 10): the shared 0-8 ($26, $CF, $28, $57, $39/$36, $B7/$BC, $98, $59, $76) and $46, $46, $E6, $E6 for tile 9.
